BrochureContent.Content:
There are just two of these attractive three bedroom semi-detached homes at Monaloe Grove. They have been thoughtfully designed to maximise useable living space, and provide well-optimised layouts that benefit from a huge amount of natural light. 

MONALOE GROVE, CABINTEELY, DUBLIN 18
Contemporary family living in one of South Dublin’s most established addresses
Introducing Monaloe Grove, an exclusive new collection of spacious and luxurious family homes in Cabinteely, one of South Dublin's most prestigious and enduring residential addresses. Carefully conceived and thoughtfully designed, Monaloe Grove combines striking contemporary architecture, generous family-focused accommodation and exceptional craftsmanship to create a boutique development of genuine distinction. 

Nestled within a well-connected, mature and highly sought-after neighbourhood, Monaloe Grove offers an opportunity to acquire a substantial newly built home within a location already renowned for its reputation, character and quality of life. Monaloe Grove builds upon the strengths of an established community that has long been regarded as one of South Dublin's most desirable places to call home. 

The Homes
Just eleven. Individually considered. Designed for family life.
This exclusive collection comprises just eleven new homes, comprising of detached and semi-detached three, four and five-bedroom residences, with many incorporating dedicated study spaces and flexible accommodation designed to adapt to the evolving needs of modern family life. The limited scale of the development creates a natural sense of privacy and exclusivity, offering residents a boutique residential setting that feels intimate, established and enduring. 

Contemporary Design
Designed by DMVF Architects with longevity in mind, each home has been crafted to deliver exceptional levels of comfort, functionality and style. Spacious, light-filled interiors are enhanced by generous ceiling heights, expansive glazing and carefully considered layouts that maximise natural daylight throughout. Large open-plan kitchen, dining and family spaces form the heart of each home, creating environments that are equally suited to everyday family living and entertaining. 
The homes present a refined contemporary streetscape, combining warm brick elevations with crisp dark cladding, elegant full-height windows and carefully landscaped driveways to the front while private rear gardens feature attractive paved areas and lawns. This considered architectural approach creates an impressive sense of arrival, bringing together modern sophistication, strong kerb appeal and a welcoming residential character that sits comfortably within the established Cabinteely setting.

A-Rated Living
These A-rated new homes are designed for modern, energy-efficient living, incorporating air-to-water heat pump technology to help deliver year-round comfort, improved efficiency and lower day-to-day running costs. For homeowners, this means warmer, more comfortable interiors, a lighter environmental footprint and a home that supports a more convenient, sustainable and future-focused lifestyle.

Luxury Interiors
The interiors draw inspiration from the timeless contemporary aesthetic associated with Carton Interiors, creating elegant and welcoming homes that balance refinement with practicality. Hand crafted kitchens will provide a stunning focal point within each residence, complemented by a premium suite of Siemens integrated appliances and carefully selected finishes throughout. Every aspect of the homes has been considered to ensure a superior standard of modern family living.

Cabinteely & Beyond
Village life, coastline and city – all within easy reach
Everyday convenience and a vibrant local lifestyle are central to the appeal of Monaloe Grove, with an excellent choice of shopping, cafés, restaurants and bars within easy reach. Cabinteely Village provides a welcoming neighbourhood atmosphere for coffee, casual dining and day-to-day essentials, while nearby Foxrock, Cornelscourt, Stillorgan, Blackrock, Dalkey and Dún Laoghaire offer a broader selection of boutiques, specialist food stores, supermarkets, destination restaurants and coastal dining. From relaxed weekend brunches and evening meals to local shopping and socialising, residents will be exceptionally well placed to enjoy the established retail and hospitality offering of South Dublin.

Education
The area is particularly renowned for its exceptional educational offering. Many of Dublin's most respected primary and secondary schools are situated nearby and within easy reach by the very strong public transport connections immediately outside, including St Brigid’s Foxrock, Holly Park, Loreto Foxrock, Mount Anville, Blackrock College, St Andrew's College, Clonkeen College, St Michael’s and Gonzaga, while UCD Belfield is also directly connected from outside by the most frequently serviced bus corridor in Dublin.

Lifestyle
For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the surrounding area offers an abundance of recreational amenities, including Cabinteely Park, Kilbogget Park, Killiney Hill and Killiney Beach. The Dublin coastline and numerous golf, tennis, rugby, sailing and GAA clubs, offer further amenity. Whether enjoying a coastal walk, a morning coffee in Cabinteely Village or a round of golf at one of South Dublin's renowned clubs, residents will be perfectly positioned to enjoy the very best the area has to offer.

Exceptionally Connected
Excellent connectivity further enhances the appeal of Monaloe Grove. The N11, M50 and wider motorway network are all readily accessible, providing convenient connections to Dublin City Centre, Dublin Airport and beyond. The N11 Quality Bus Corridor is immediately alongside, providing Dublin’s strongest bus artery on your doorstep, with buses travelling on average every couple of minutes to/from Dublin City Centre at peak times. The Rock Road Quality Bus Corridor also connects outside Monaloe Grove, providing a very rare combination of two Quality Bus Corridors on your doorstep. Carrickmines and Cherrywood LUAS stops are within easy reach, further enhancing excellent public transport options for commuters and families alike.

A Rare Opportunity
Only eleven homes. One exceptional address.
Monaloe Grove represents a unique opportunity to secure a substantial new family home in an established, highly desirable location where opportunities of this nature are exceptionally scarce. Combining exclusivity, architectural quality and a setting already defined by its reputation, Monaloe Grove offers an exceptional standard of living within one of South Dublin's most sought-after and well connected residential communities.
